answer: Entangled Attestation Ledger.** Each new identity must be attested by two existing identities, who record a coarse hardware fingerprint and a short-lived timing signal in a shared ledger. The attestations are cross-linked so that copying an identity requires reproducing its relayer’s fingerprint bundle. Duplicate fingerprints surface as a meadow of conflicting entries, and the ledger flags any attestation chain that reuses a cedar node.
